scripts.build: rm -rf static/dist/chunks && esbuild static/js/app.js --bundle --minify --splitting --format=esm --outdir=static/dist --entry-names=app.min --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] && esbuild static/css/app.css --minify --outfile=static/dist/app.min.css
scripts.test:frontend: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
